data.exact_reserve_text: Prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k, taking the total due from members and the Lloyd's Central Fund (LCF) to GBP 45,158k, this amount was settled during the financial year. there was an underwriting loss of GBP 37,641k (before expenses and investment return) attributable to the reinsurance to close of the 2008 to 2013 pure years of accounts.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 43.474 million in prior year reserves. This was primarily driven by a GBP 5.833 million strengthening for the 2007 underwriting year, specifically related to Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves, and an underwriting loss of GBP 37.641 million attributable to the reinsurance to close of the 2008 to 2013 pure years of accounts. The overall loss experience on all years of account was worse than anticipated, leading to reserves being strengthened to reflect this adverse claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table on page 17 is distorted by the closure of the 2007, 2013, and 2014 underwriting years via Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions in 2016, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. Therefore, prior year development was derived from explicit statements in the managing agent's report and closed year of account reports.
